description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git's handling of CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) conversions, including configurations like core.autocrlf and core.safecrlf, and various scenarios such as patch application, checkout, and .gitattributes handling.

methods.name: has_cr
methods.description: Checks if a file contains CR (carriage return) characters by filtering through 'tr' and 'grep'.

methods.name: munge_cr
methods.description: Adds or removes CRs to a disk file in-place by invoking specific sub-functions 'append_cr' or 'remove_cr' and replacing the original file.

methods.name: cr_to_Q_no_NL
methods.description: Converts CR characters in input to 'Q' and removes newlines, used in testing CRLF conversions with autocrlf.
